translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Sábado jamay junagcho wanush maquiyog runata Jesucristo aliyäsishgan
Saypita say marcacho sinagogaman yaycurir Jesús ricargan juc runa jucag maquin wanush caycagta.
Saymi chiquegnincuna Jesusta ricapaycäyargan sábado jamay junagcho aliyäsiptenga say achäquila contran sharcuyänanpä.
Sayno yarpaycäyashganta musyarmi wanush maquiyog runata Jesús nergan: “Sharcurcur runacunapa naupanman ichicuy.”
Nircurna runacunata Jesús taporgan: “Sábado jamay junagcho ¿gueshyaycag runata aliyäsishwancu o ‘Jina nacacusunpis’ nishwancu?” Sayno niptin runacuna manami imatapis niyargansu.
Mana cuyapäcog cayashganta musyarmi Jesús ajanash paycunata ricärergan. Nircurnami maquin wanush runata nergan: “¡Maquiquita jogariy!” Jogarcuptinmi maquin sänuna ricacorgan.
Sábado jamay junagcho sayno aliyäsiptinmi fariseo runacuna yarguriyashpan Herodispa favornin cag runacunawan wilanacuyargan Jesusta wanusiyänanpä.
Jesucristuwan asca runa shuntacäyashgan
Sinagogapita yargurirnami discïpuluncunawan Jesús aywacorgan Galilea gocha cuchunman. Saypa aywaptinmi Galilea runacuna saysica paypa guepanpa aywayargan.
Milagro rurashgancunata musyashpanmi runacuna Jesús cagman aywayargan Judea provinciapita, Jerusalenpita, Idumea provinciapita, Jordán mayu wac simpanpita, Tiro marcapita y Sidón marcapitapis.

Gueshyagcunata saycho aliyäsiptinmi waquin gueshyagcunapis Jesús caycashgan cagman imaycanöpa yaycuyta munayargan yataylapis yataycuyänanpä. Sayno juntapäyaptinmi discïpuluncunata Jesús nergan: “Büquita alistashla caycäsiyay runacuna aläpa juntapäyämaptin sayman wisänäpä.”
Saychömi supaycuna löcuyäsiyashgan runacunapis Jesuspa puntanman gongurpacuycur gaparashpan niyargan: “¡Gamga canqui lapanpä munayyog Diospa surinmi!”
Sayno gaparäyaptinmi say supaycunata Jesús olgutupargan upälacuyänanpä.
Chunca ishcay apostolnincunata Jesucristo acrashgan

Saypitanami jircaman Jesús wisaptin paywan aywagcuna quëdayargan jirca chaquincho. Nircurmi paycunapita chunca ishcayta (12) gayasergan say jircaman wisäyänanpä. Paycunatami acrargan paywan puriyänanpä, Tayta Diosninsipa wilacuyninta wilacuyänanpä,
runacunapita supaycunata garguyänanpä [y gueshyagcunata aliyäsiyänanpäpis].
Say acrashgancunapa jutincunami cayargan Simón (paypa jutinta trucasergan Pedro cananpä)
y Zebedeupa surincuna Santiago y Juan. Santiagutawan Juanta Jesús cuyay jutinta churapargan “Boanerges” nishpan. “Boanerges” nishganga “Magacuypa Surin” ninanmi.
Waquin cagpa jutinmi cargan Andrés, Felipe, Bartolomé, Mateo, Tomás, Alfeupa surin Santiago, Tadeo, “Celote” nishgan Simón,
y Jesusta entregag cag Judas Iscariote.
Satanaspa munayninwan cashganta Jesucristupä niyashgan
Saypita posädaraycashgan wayiman Jesús cutiptinmi saymanpis asca runacuna yapay shuntacäyargan. Saymi tiempun cargansu discïpuluncunawan micuyänalanpäpis.
Jesús sayno caycashganta musyarmi castancuna yarpäyargan löcuyash caycashganta. Saymi pay caycashgan cag wayiman aywayargan shuntayänanpä.

Saynöpis Jerusalenpita chaycur Moisés guelgashgan leycunata yachasegcuna niyargan: “Cay runaga manami Tayta Diospa munayninwansu supaycunata runacunapita gargun, sinöga supaycunapa mandagnin Beelzebupa
munayninwanmi.”
Lutanta sayno parlaycäyashganta musyarmi Jesús paycunata gayarcasir tantyasergan: “Satanasga manami pitapis yanapansu supaycunata gargunanpä.
Musyashgansinöpis juc nación ishcayman raquicash car quiquinpura chiquinacorga ushacäyanmi.
Saynöpis juc wayicho tagcuna quiquinpura chiquinacorga ¿manasurä wacpa caypa aywacur ushacäyanman?
Saynölami supaycunata gargunanpä Satanás pitapis yanaparga gargunacur ushacanman.”
Satanaspita más munayyog cashganta tantyasirmi Jesús yachasergan: “Calpayog runa wayinta täpaycaptenga manami pipis suwapanmansu.
Sayno täpaycaptinpis paypita más calpayog runa shamurmi isanga pancaycur imancunatapis apacurcur aywaconga.
“Runacuna ima jusalicuyashganta y lutancunata parlayashgantapis perdonta manacuyaptenga Tayta Dios perdonangapämi.
Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashgäta Santu Espíritu tantyaycäsiptin conträ parlagcunatami isanga Tayta Diosninsi imaypis perdonangapäsu.”
“Satanaspa munayninwanmi runacunapita supaycunata garguycan” nir runacuna contran parlaptinmi Jesús sayno nergan.
Maman y wauguincuna pï cashgantapis Jesucristo nishgan
Saypitami Jesuspa mamanwan wauguincuna chäyargan pay yachaycäsishgan wayi puncuman. Saycho asca runacuna cayaptinmi yaycuyta mana camäpacur Jesusta gayasiyargan wagtalaman.
Saymi Jesuspa naupancho waquin jamaraycagcuna wilayargan: “Mamayquiwan wauguiquicunami puncucho shuyaraycäyäshunqui” nir.
Sayno wilayaptinmi naupancho jamaraycagcunata ricärir Jesús nergan: “Paycunami mamäno y wauguëcunano caycäyan.
Pipis mamäno, wauguëcunano y panëcunano caycäyan Tayta Dios munashganno cawag cagmi.”

footnotes.text: Runacunata maquincho sarararmi Satanás caycan wayinta täpag calpayog runano.
